column5: The request-owned policy inputs cross one immutable route seam with logical target and optional physical proxy. Global client configuration, async selection, and unrelated KV knobs remain external.
Leader, follower, mixed, prefer-leader, stale, and learner access modes feed the sole route decision without a duplicate mutable wrapper. TiFlash, flashback, and async access paths remain external.
